text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sha, sha, sha, SHAAAAHHH!!!! Did you see 
that?! That's my win!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Losing to a weirdo like this... Seriously, 
no way...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's your deal, you tryin' to act 
tough? You still wanna go? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm, like, seriously ticked off. Just so 
you know, it's not ending like this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna win next time. In, 
like, a big race."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a big one, right?! Alright, bring it 
on!!

I might end up competing against Tosen 
Jordan again in the near future.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just remembered I was told to hand you 
this. Later.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
First it was the "Su" I got from Flash the 
other day, and now "kan"... I see.

Still, with Tosen Jordan handing over a 
keyword right after Eishin Flash... that 
means—

There is no doubt someone entrusted those 
things to them.
choice_data_list: (I wonder who asked her to do that...?)

text_block_list.text:
Whose motives could possibly lie behind 
this Eden Gold Ship is chasing...? I 
couldn't help but wonder a little.
